description: A photo of either kind: ANALYSIS (belongs to an analysis) or PROGRESS (belongs to a log day) (tables PHOTO, ANALYSIS_PHOTO, PROGRESS_PHOTO).

user_id.description: Owner of the photo, copied for erasure and URL checks.

object_key.description: Random key of the file in the object store, photos/ followed by 36 hex digits and hyphens.

content_type.description: File type: image/jpeg, image/png or image/webp.

analysis_id.description: ANALYSIS only: the analysis the photo belongs to.

shot_type.description: ANALYSIS only: front, left or right.

heatmap_key.description: ANALYSIS only: key of the Grad-CAM image, heatmaps/ followed by 36 hex digits and hyphens.

log_id.description: PROGRESS only: the log day the photo belongs to.

caption.description: PROGRESS only: caption of at most 140 characters.
